name: Security Scan
description: Automated website security audits (OWASP ZAP, Nuclei, testssl.sh) driven by an AI agent in an isolated Kali toolbox; findings rendered to a shareable webpage report.

capabilities.name: Security Scan (Beta)
capabilities.description: Run an automated website security audit against a URL you are authorised to scan.

requirements.notes: Requires the docker socket mounted into the API container and the SECURITY_* env from docker-compose.security.override.yml. The beeflow-security-tools scanner image is NOT bundled — provision it once after install from the Studio Security tab (Build from the shipped Dockerfile, or Pull from a configured registry ref).
